text:
[RDSC.5a.10.2] `element_type` is the slot's, `Float` or `Int` ([LSIG.1.1]).
`time_model` is `SERIES_TIME_MODEL_SLIDING` with `window_ns > 0`, or
`SERIES_TIME_MODEL_ALL_TIME` with `window_ns` 0: the compiler refuses every
`tumbling` line ([LSER.18.1]). `gap_policy` is the series' gap policy
([LSIG.3]) and `null_policy` its `nulls:` policy ([LNUL.8.6]); neither stands
for the other, and [LSIG.2.3.6] says why the body carries `time_model` and
`gap_policy` both. `identity_slot_name` is empty for a series keyed `by: none`
([LSER.7.6.2]). `max_samples` carries the series' `capacity` ([LSER.13.14]),
`0` when it declares none, and a full backing refuses ([LSIG.1.1]).
